entities.name: Jamil Sidqi al-Zahawi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jamil Sidqi al-Zahawi was a prominent Iraqi poet and philosopher. He is regarded as one of the greatest contemporary poets of the Arab world and was known for his defence of women's rights.
